==Geography ==
*[[Abeltoppen]], a mountain in [[Dickson Land]] at [[Spitsbergen]], [[Svalbard]].<ref>{{cite encyclopedia|encyclopedia=Norsk Fjelleksikon|title=Abeltoppen|editor-first=Per Roger |editor-last=Lauritzen |editor-link=Per Roger Lauritzen |year=2009 |publisher=Friluftsforlaget |location=Arendal |language=Norwegian |isbn=978-82-91-49547-7}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://placenames.npolar.no/stadnamn/Abeltoppen |title=Abeltoppen (Svalbard) |publisher=[[Norwegian Polar Institute]] |accessdate=10 March 2015}}</ref>
* {{interlanguage link|Rue Abel|fr}}, a street in the [[12th arrondissement of Paris|12th arrondissement]] of [[Paris]] in front of the [[Gare de Lyon]] mainline station.
